app.title: Elena — Road to the BFA
app.tagline: Every deadline, audition, and requirement in one place.

nyc.label: New York City area
nyc.note: Four schools audition in/around NYC (Jan-Mar). One or two well-timed trips can cover several. Purchase is Westchester, ~35 min from Grand Central.

socal.label: Southern California
socal.note: USC (LA), LMU (Westchester, ~12 mi from USC) and Chapman (Orange, ~40 mi) are combinable into one Southern California trip. LMU's audition is video-only, so it needs no travel of its own.

boston.label: Boston
boston.note: Boston Conservatory offers a live-online audition — may avoid the flight.

tucson.label: Tucson, AZ
tucson.note: Video-only audition accepted, but an in-person Sept/Jan date (before ~Feb 1) preserves first-year Dance Merit talent aid.

lastRefresh.summary: Re-verified all 9 schools against live sources. Another quiet week: Pace's Jan 3 → Jan 4 Sands pre-screen pendingChange reconfirmed for a THIRD consecutive week, now echoed on two more Pace pages (still not auto-accepted — needs a human to move proposedValue into value). Fordham/Ailey's apply page still shows "Applications have closed" with no split Nov 6/Nov 8 dates, so that conflict remains unresolved. Boston Conservatory's audition-requirements page revealed a previously-uncaptured request-only, fully pre-recorded video audition fallback for applicants who can't attend in person or live online. NYU Tisch, SUNY Purchase, LMU, USC Kaufman, Chapman, and Arizona's previously confirmed deadlines, fees, and audition dates all reconfirmed unchanged. Fordham's general fordham.edu pages remain bot-blocked (CAS login gateway).
